notes: Only Chinese and English speech samples are installed locally; Japanese/Korean/Russian/French/German/Spanish/Portuguese/Italian use the same Whisper language flag, native prompt and source-code mapping but were not physically recorded.
Auto detection runs on the first spoken chunk and then locks the detected language for the session; the first auto chunk is about 1 s slower because of language detection.
Recognition language is also editable from the audio subtitle bar; changing it writes settings.audio.language and refreshes the bar.
Free translation only; no paid AI quota used. QA used an isolated user-data-dir/TEMP.
final_artifact_verified: Audio 5/5 on the final packaged build; screenshot language round 1/1 and realtime 2/2 regression also passed.
